patterns.message: D4: live adapters must not import demo fixtures. Backend-unservable data stays mocked and labeled at the seam (src/api/index.ts), never fabricated inside an HTTP adapter.
D4: live adapters must not import the price simulator. Live quotes come from the mnd facade in Wave B0 (HKP-MND-1).
D4: live adapters must not seed values from a PRNG. Missing data stays missing (plan §6).
D4: client-side plan heuristics are deleted from live mode (plan §3.3).
